verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability for creating and organizing shared docs or notes alongside project work. The nearest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself: card-back discussion, a personal Inbox for capturing details, an AI writing-assist feature, and third-party data pulled in through Power-Ups. None of these shows shared documents or notes that can be created and organized.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
